instruction: Write an XDP/eBPF program that increments exactly one of two per-CPU counters for IPv4 and non-IPv4 frames, then returns XDP_PASS. Define a per-CPU array map named 'ip_split_counter' (type BPF_MAP_TYPE_PERCPU_ARRAY, key __u32 [0=IPv4, 1=non-IPv4], val __u64 count, max_entries 2). Check Ethernet header: if eth->h_proto == bpf_htons(ETH_P_IP), increment slot 0; otherwise (ARP, IPv6, VLAN, 802.3, runts), increment slot 1. Return XDP_PASS for all frames.
requirements: If eth->h_proto == bpf_htons(ETH_P_IP), slot = 0; else slot = 1
GPL license and SEC("xdp") entry point

tests.name: ipv4_tcp_slot0
tests.description: IPv4 TCP frame increments slot 0 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: ipv4_udp_slot0
tests.description: IPv4 UDP frame increments slot 0 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: arp_slot1
tests.description: ARP frame (non-IPv4) increments slot 1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: ipv6_slot1
tests.description: IPv6 frame (0x86DD) increments slot 1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: vlan_slot1
tests.description: VLAN tagged frame (0x8100) increments slot 1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: runt_slot1
tests.description: Runt frame (14 bytes non-IPv4) increments slot 1 and returns XDP_PASS
